name: FL02-Excel-Processing-Demo
description: Excel processing, export generation, and related SharePoint record creation

trigger.operation: When a file is created or modified (properties only)

actions.name: MarkFileAsProcessing
actions.note: Set the source file status to Processing before starting Excel operations. This prevents the Validated trigger condition from matching subsequent file modifications.

actions.name: ProcessExcelRecords
primaryRecord: Reset LastPrimaryReferenceCode to an empty string
If creation succeeds, save the created item ID in LastPrimaryRecordId
If creation succeeds, save the current record ReferenceCode in LastPrimaryReferenceCode
If creation fails, increment SharePointErrors and append creation error details
associatedRecord: Verify that LastPrimaryRecordId is greater than 0
Verify that the current record ReferenceCode matches LastPrimaryReferenceCode
If no valid primary record exists or ReferenceCode does not match, skip associated record creation and append a diagnostic entry
If both validations succeed, create associated SharePoint item with ParentRecordId set to LastPrimaryRecordId
Increment RecordsCreated if SharePoint item creation succeeds
Increment SharePointErrors and append creation error details if SharePoint item creation fails

details: Count failed SharePoint record creation operations
actions.name: CalculateFinalDiagnostics
MarkFileAsProcessed
actions.condition: Main processing completed successfully AND SharePointErrors = 0
actions.note: Mark the source document as Processed only after successful completion of the processing workflow and FL04 logging.

actions.name: MarkFileAsError
actions.condition: Main processing failed OR SharePointErrors > 0 OR FL04 logging failed
actions.note: Mark the source document as Error when processing cannot complete successfully, when SharePoint record creation errors are detected, or when execution logging fails. The error branch must also handle failures that prevent FL04 from running.

relatedFlows.purpose: Scheduled cleanup of temporary Excel files

implementationStatus: Conceptual demonstration - Not an importable Power Automate flow
